system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 11. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (23 seconds, code score 0.94) ---
[b00] JULIANA (furious, defiant): "You have already taken enough from me. Leave!"
[b01] GERALD (aggressive, snarl): "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
[b02] JULIANA (incredulous, gasping): "What? When?"
[b03] GERALD (cold, certain): "The last time I came here."
[b04] JULIANA (contemptuous, outraged): "You never even entered the cottage!"
[b05] GERALD (smug, threatening): "Then you should have nothing to fear from a search."
[b06] JULIANA (adamant, protective): "Alexander would never steal from you."
[b07] GERALD (mocking, spiteful): "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
[b08] ALEXANDER (low, menacing): "Choose your next words carefully."
[b09] GERALD (shouting, dramatic): "You hear that? He threatens me again!"

--- WINDOW 1 (34 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] CONSTABLE (cold, procedural): "Then a search will settle the matter."
[b01] JULIANA (desperate, shouting): "You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!"
[b02] GERALD (taunting): "If he has nothing to hide..."
[b03] GERALD (smug): "...let the constable search."
[b04] ALEXANDER (dark, grated): "Search it."
[b05] ALEXANDER (resigned, calm): "Let them."
[b06] SFX: Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
[b07] ACTION: The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
[b08] JULIANA (distressed, pleading): "Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!"
[b09] ACTION: The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
[b10] JULIANA (crying, desperate): "Please! There is nothing here!"
[b11] CONSTABLE (cold, indifferent): "Then you have nothing to fear."
[b12] JULIANA (heartbroken, sobbing): "Those are all I have left!"
[b13] GERALD (cruel, condescending): "Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief."
[b14] JULIANA (furious, accusatory): "You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!"

--- WINDOW 2 (27 seconds, code score 0.87) ---
[b00] JULIANA (heartbroken, sobbing): "Those are all I have left!"
[b01] GERALD (cruel, condescending): "Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief."
[b02] JULIANA (furious, accusatory): "You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!"
[b03] GERALD (scoffing, sinister): "Happy?"
[b04] GERALD (provoking, smirking): "What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?"
[b05] JULIANA (whispering, terrified): "Don't!"
[b06] ALEXANDER (haunted, resolute): "One blow would end this."
[b07] ALEXANDER (pained, selfless): "But one blow would destroy her life."
[b08] ACTION: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
[b09] JULIANA (startled, shouting): "That is his coat!"

--- WINDOW 3 (21 seconds, code score 0.70) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (haunted, resolute): "One blow would end this."
[b01] ALEXANDER (pained, selfless): "But one blow would destroy her life."
[b02] ACTION: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
[b03] JULIANA (startled, shouting): "That is his coat!"
[b04] SFX: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
[b05] ACTION: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
[b06] GERALD (gloating, victorious): "There it is. Ha!"

Pick the single best promo.
